April 10, 2018 - By Linda Rogers 
United Services Automobile Association increased its stake in Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) by 4.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. United Services Automobile Association bought 355,621 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.71% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 8.84 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $338.52M, up from 8.48 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. United Services Automobile Association who had been investing in Cisco Systems Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $205.28B market cap company. The stock increased 3.50% or $1.44 during the last trading session, reaching $42.61. About 18.28M shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 25.57% since April 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.02% the S&P500. 
London Co Of Virginia increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 1.21% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
